_README: How the fourteen trades are divided in the Services menu and the footer, the way content/areas.json divides the thirty-four cities by valley. Separate from services.json on purpose: that file is machine-extracted from the recovered site by build/extract.mjs, and this is an authored editorial decision about presentation — keeping them apart means re-running the extractor cannot quietly clobber the grouping. Unlike the valleys, where a city may sit in two regions, every trade belongs to exactly one group: a menu that lists Roofing twice is a menu that has stopped being an index. d01.test.mjs fails the build if a trade falls out of the groups or appears in two.
